gaps.finding: Authenticated rendering is covered, but slot/service/token create-update-delete behavior has no dedicated action/mobile E2E contract.
Backend guards have unit/architecture coverage, but authenticated browser action, race/error, and page-specific mobile coverage is incomplete.
Shared upload/analytics parser code is tested below the browser, but upload/delete/analyze flows and page-specific mobile states lack authenticated E2E proof.
Routes and backend contracts exist, while page-specific loading/empty/error/stale and five-width mobile verification remains partial.
The DEV catalog labels every tool ready although readiness currently means routed/implemented, not complete authenticated action and mobile coverage.
